description: CrewBus M4 spike: loopback-only grant. Shell may spawn ONLY the bundled node sidecar (externalBin binaries/node) to run the crewbus core (serve --port 0) — no PATH fallback exists, so no execute scope is granted. Frontend fetch is browser-native, fenced by the CSP connect-src (loopback only); no fs scope; no remote capability whatsoever.
